{{recipe}} 

This ketchup recipe does not call for something you've never heard of, and does not call to simmer for 3 hours like some other recipes do!

== Ingredients ==
* 24 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Malt vinegar|malt vinegar]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Onion Powder|onion powder]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium-high heat. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] and cook for 15 minutes.
#Keep refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks, or freeze up to 2 months.

== See also ==
* [[Cookbook:Ketchup|Ketchup]]
